blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: CVC recommendations hold advisory status and are not legally binding on the government.
The Commission lacks autonomous powers to directly register criminal cases.
Implementation of investigative proceedings and penal actions relies entirely on the CBI and respective departments.
Questions often test the binding nature of CVC advice: remember, recommendations are advisory, not binding.
CVC cannot directly register criminal cases; it must route them through investigating agencies like the CBI.

blocks.content: • Depends on CBI and departments for action.
